action_summary: Reverted the v17 regression by removing the six rm -rf commands that deleted fold_models/model_0..model_5, so the full BiEncoder fold ensemble is blended again with blend_strategy='sigmoid' (the best configuration, v16 = 0.38513). Added Spearman-oriented post-processing: train.csv is loaded and, for each target column with at most 12 distinct train values, test predictions are quantile-mapped by rank onto the empirical train level distribution. This preserves the model ranking while reproducing the heavy tie structure of the discrete targets (reducing noise ordering within tied groups), with guards that fall back to raw predictions if a column would become constant. Predictions are nan-sanitized and clipped to [0,1] and the submission is cast to float before writing submission.csv.
